name: purs-puppy
description: An LR parser generator for PureScript
author: katsujukou

scripts.bundle: cd .. && spago build -p puppy-cli --pure && purs-backend-es bundle-module -p node -m Puppy.CLI.Main -t cli/lib/bundle.js
scripts.version: echo 'export const version = "v'$npm_package_version'";' > ./src/Puppy/CLI/Version.js && git add package.json ./src/Puppy/CLI/Version.js
